The position of '''den mother''' referred to the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Queen/Legends|leader]] of a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Den (Selonian)|den]].<ref name="Selonian Uprising" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a spacer met the [[Kiisa Kimotte|den mother]] of the [[Neetha Den]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG:AtDM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Address the Den Mother|Talus}}</ref>
